title: Polars: columnar data engineering
summary: A complete route through typed tables, expression semantics, temporal correctness, lazy execution, Arrow interoperability, measured performance and validated data publication.

lessons.title: Rows, columns, schemas and expressions
lessons.outcome: Construct and verify a typed table with a stated row grain.
lessons.lab: Run the two complete local cases, then make and explain the six specified changes while preserving the stated row and type contracts.
lessons.verification: Run the assertions and inspect polars-001 reference checks passed. Interpret the counterexample in the guide.
